Two defensive alignment cards — Zone (3-2-2) and Man-Free. Print one per player per game.

🔵 Zone Defense — 3-2-2
1Middle — 7 yds over center. Step up at snap. Cover hook/middle 0–10 yds. Watch QB eyes.
2L Flat — 3–7 yds off LOS over L slot. Back-pedal. Cover flat zone. Stop short routes & runs to your side.
3R Flat — Mirror of #2 on right side.
4L Corner — 3–10 yds over L WR. Back-pedal. Don't let anyone get behind you. Pass deep to #6.
5R Corner — Mirror of #4 on right side.
6L Safety — 7–10 yds deep. NEVER let anyone get behind you. Break when ball is thrown.
7R Safety — Mirror of #6 on right side.
Middle/Flat Corner Safety
🟣 Man-Free Defense
1Middle — 7 yds over center. No specific man. Watch for runs & quick handoffs. Cover for blitzers.
2Slot Def → RB. 2–7 yds off LOS. Follow your man everywhere they go.
3Slot Def → Y (R Slot). Same: follow your man.
4Slot Def → H (L Slot). Same: follow your man.
5Corner → Z (R WR). 2–7 yds off. Own the sideline. Cross? Yell SWITCH!
6Corner → X (L WR). Mirror of #5.
7FREE Safety — 7–10 yds deep. No man. Always deeper than the deepest. Help anyone beat deep.
Middle (free) Man coverage Free Safety — Gold arrows = coverage assignments
